limitations: The exact spectrum is confined to the eight finite fields of size at most eleven; a length-thirteen prime-field ordering is a single explicit witness, not an exhaustive census of that field. Unindexed computational overlap and unseen journal-version material remain possible.
scientific_integrity: The enumerator has an explicit exhaustive finite domain, two independent longest-subsequence implementations, field-model descriptions, complete expected outputs, and source comparisons. Its verification is internal; no independent external audit or validation has occurred.
title: Exact small-field insertion–deletion spectra of full-length dimension-two Reed–Solomon codes
